sn4.25:1.1: Atha kho Māro pāpimā Bhagavato santike imā nibbejaniyā gāthāyo abhāsitvā tamhā ṭhānā apakkamma Bhagavato avidūre pathaviyaṃ pallaṅkena nisīdi tuṇhī bhūto maṅku-bhūto pattakkhandho adhomukho pajjhāyanto appaṭibhāno kaṭṭhena bhūmiṃ vilikhanto || || 1.
sn4.25:1.2: Atha kho Taṇhā ca Arati ca Ragā ca māra-dhītaro yena Māro pāpimā ten-upasaṅkamiṃsu || Upasaṅkamitvā Māraṃ pāpimantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsiṃsu || ||
sn4.25:4.1: Atha kho Taṇhā ca Arati ca Ragā ca māra-dhītaro yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam etad avocuṃ || ||
sn4.25:4.3: Atha kho Bhagavā na manasākāsi yathā taṃ anuttare upadhi-saṅkhaye vimutto || 4.
sn4.25:5.1: Atha kho Taṇhā ca Arati ca Ragā ca māra-dhītaro ekam antam apakkamma evaṃ samañcintesaṃ || ||
sn4.25:5.3: yaṃ nūna mayam ekasatam ekasataṃ kumārivaṇṇasatam abbinimmineyyāmā ti || || 5.
sn4.25:5.4: Atha kho Taṇhā ca Arati ca Ragā ca māra-dhītaro ekasatam ekasataṃ kumārivaṇṇasatam abhinimminitvā yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam etad avocuṃ || ||
sn4.25:5.6: Taṃ pi Bhagavā na manasākāsi yathā tam anuttare upadhisaṅkhaye vimutto || || 6.
sn4.25:6.1: Atha kho Taṇhā ca Arati ca Ragā ca māra-dhītaro ekam antam apakkamma evaṃ samacintesuṃ ||
sn4.25:6.3: yaṃ nūna mayam ekasatam ekasatam avijātavaṇṇasatam abhinimmineyyāmā ti || || 7.
sn4.25:6.4: Atha kho Taṇhā ca Arati ca Ragā ca māra-dhītaro ekasatam ekasatam avijātavaṇṇasatam abhinimminitvā yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam etad avocuṃ ||
sn4.25:6.6: Taṃ pi Bhagavā na manasākāsi yathā tam anuttare upadhisaṅkhaye vimutto || || 8.
sn4.25:7.4: sakiṃ vijātavaṇṇasataṃ abhinimminitvā yena Bhagavā || pa ||
sn4.25:9.6: Atha kho Taṇhā ca Arati ca Ragā ca Māra-dhītaro ekam antam apakkamma etad avocuṃ || ||
sn4.25:11.1: hi mayaṃ samaṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā avītarāgam iminā upakkamena upakkameyyāma hadayaṃ vāssa phaleyya || uṇhaṃ lohitaṃ vā mukhato uggaccheyya || ummādam va pāpuṇeyya cittavikkhepaṃ vā ||
sn4.25:11.2: seyyathā vā pana naḷo harito luto ussussati visussati milāyati ||
sn4.25:11.3: evam eva ussusseyya visusseyya milāyeyyā ti || || 14.
sn4.25:12.1: Atha kho Taṇhā ca Arati ca Ragā ca māradhītaro yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā ekam antam aṭṭhaṃsu || 15.
sn4.25:12.2: Ekam antam ṭhitā kho Taṇhā māradhītā Bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn4.25:13.5: sakkhī na sampajjati kenaci te ti || || 16.
sn4.25:14.5: sakkhī na sampajjati kenaci me ti || || 17.
sn4.25:15.1: Atha kho Arati māra-dhītā Bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi ||
sn4.25:17.4: na kuppati na sarati ve na thino || ||
sn4.25:19.1: Atha kho Ragā ca māra-dhītā Bhagavato santike imaṃ santi gātham abhāsi || ||
sn4.25:22.1: Atha kho Taṇhā ca Arati ca Ragā ca māra-dhītaro yena Māro pāpimā ten-upasaṅkamiṃsu || || 22.
sn4.25:22.2: Addasā kho Māro pāpimā Taṇhaṃ ca Aratiṃ ca Ragañ ca māra-dhītaro dūrato va āgacchantiyo || ||
